recommendations.title: Pick up the pace
recommendations.message: You said you walk. You could try a faster pace for part of it. Minutes that leave you out of breath count double toward the weekly 150.
recommendations.effect_note: Modeled difference for people like you, not a promise.
recommendations.why_short: A faster pace for part of your walk is a simple next step.

recommendations.title: A bit more sleep
recommendations.message: You said you go to bed around 11. Going to bed a little earlier could help you get closer to the 7 hours CDC suggests for adults.
recommendations.effect_note: Modeled difference for people like you, not a promise.
recommendations.why_short: A regular bedtime leaves room for the sleep adults are advised to get.

recommendations.title: Sit a little less
recommendations.message: You said a lot of your sitting is watching TV. You could stand up and move around during the ads. Moving more and sitting less is good advice for everyone.
recommendations.effect_note: Modeled difference for people like you, not a promise.
recommendations.why_short: Standing and moving a bit more often breaks up long sitting.
